content.value_statement: Dark dashboard teams need consistent visual rules and accessible components. This skill provides React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion patterns for polished interfaces.
actual_capabilities: Defines a React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion stack.
Provides Tailwind color tokens, spacing, radius, shadows, and animation settings.
Shows HTML metadata, favicon, social sharing, and manifest examples.
Documents global CSS for fonts, focus states, scrollbars, and glass effects.
Includes Framer Motion variants for page transitions, hover states, and staggered content.
Lists typography and color utility classes for consistent dark interfaces.
limitations: This is a documentation skill, not a runnable component package.
Several referenced components and pages are described but not fully implemented.
Placeholder example.com metadata must be replaced before production use.
The guidance assumes React 18, Tailwind CSS 3, Vite 5, and TypeScript 5.

use_cases.title: Create an Admin Shell
use_cases.description: Build a dark application frame with routing, layout structure, and reusable visual rules.

use_cases.title: Standardize Design Tokens
use_cases.description: Convert dark theme colors, spacing, radius, shadows, and typography into Tailwind configuration.

use_cases.title: Prototype Data Dashboards
use_cases.description: Create refined dashboard screens with glass panels, status colors, and restrained motion patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Dark App
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-ui-dark-ts to scaffold a React TypeScript dashboard style. Include Tailwind setup, theme tokens, and global CSS guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Layout System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a dark admin layout using this skill. Include an app shell, sidebar, page header, cards, and accessible focus states.

prompt_templates.title: Add Motion Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the skill motion patterns to a dashboard. Use page transitions, hover feedback, and staggered list reveals without excessive animation.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Dark Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my React dashboard against frontend-ui-dark-ts. Identify token drift, weak contrast, inconsistent spacing, and missing interaction states.

output_examples.input: A developer asks for a dark React dashboard starter.
output_examples.output: A structured plan covering Vite setup, Tailwind tokens, global CSS, routing, layout components, and motion rules.

output_examples.input: A team needs consistent card and modal styling.
output_examples.output: Reusable guidance for glass cards, overlays, focus treatment, spacing, border colors, and dark typography choices.

output_examples.input: A product engineer wants smoother page changes.
output_examples.output: Animation recommendations for fade, slide, hover, tap, and stagger effects with restrained timing.

best_practices: Replace all placeholder metadata, app names, and social image URLs before release.
Keep dark theme tokens centralized in Tailwind configuration and CSS variables.
Use motion to clarify state changes, not to distract from dashboard content.
anti_patterns: Do not copy placeholder example.com URLs into production metadata.
Do not scatter one-off dark colors outside the shared token system.
Do not overuse glass effects where readability or contrast becomes weaker.

faq.question: Does this skill generate a complete application?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured guidance, configuration examples, and interface patterns for building a dark React application.

faq.question: Which frontend stack does it target?
faq.answer: It targets React 18, TypeScript 5, Vite 5, Tailwind CSS 3, and Framer Motion 11.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it include accessibility guidance?
faq.answer: It includes focus-visible styling, touch target sizing, semantic layout examples, and dark color contrast practices.

faq.question: Are the included URLs production ready?
faq.answer: No. The example.com social metadata URLs are placeholders and must be replaced.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to install automatically?
faq.answer: The reviewed file is documentation-only and contains no executable runtime code. Setup commands should still be reviewed before use.
